sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten West Rutland justices of the peace: Marci Barrows, Thomas Burditt, Patricia Kulig, Paul Kulig, Elizabeth Moser, David O'Rourke, Barbara Trepanier, Tammy Mclaren, Luann Graves, and John M.
